exposure: Patients with stillbirth who required blood transfusion
Patients with stillbirth who did not require blood transfusion
cohort: 76 patients experiencing stillbirth due to placental abruption
finding: Most patients experiencing stillbirth due to placental abruption required blood transfusion, with lower hematocrit levels, vaginal bleeding, and preeclampsia being predictors of transfusion need.
mod_finding: Most patients experiencing stillbirth due to placental abruption required blood transfusion, with mode of delivery not differing between those who did and did not require transfusion.
